scene: At IKEA furniture showroom, Buddy has claimed a plush sectional sofa and nestled into a loose pile of big pillows. Neet is on the same sofa, solemnly pressing the next cushion with both fine forepaws as a comfort inspector. Buddy’s head rests on one pillow, happy drowsy eyes; his long continuous torso lies in a gap between pillows with visible shoulders to haunch and two naturally forward forepaws, not a detached head in cushions. Neet stands on all four legs with forepaws pressing soft cushion, full narrow torso and tiny nub seen in three-quarter view; legs rooted and cushions visibly dented under paws. Funny contrast of professional testing and already moved-in satisfaction. A few chair and stool showroom silhouettes far behind, no logos, labels, humans or collars. Soft neutral daytime interior. No clothes.
placement_after: Meanwhile, Buddy bounded enthusiastically onto a plush sectional sofa and promptly disappeared into a mountain of pillows, barking, “I’ve found paradise!”
alt_text: Buddy has already moved into the showroom sofa while Neet continues his cushion inspection.
